featured.title: UPI Merchant Fee Rollout May Be Deferred to January 2027 Amid Retailer Pushback
featured.excerpt: Less than a week before the 0.40% UPI merchant fee was due to begin, retailers and fintech firms are pressing NPCI to delay it until January 2027 — and a decision is expected within days.
featured.image_caption: A UPI payment being made via a smartphone QR code scan. India may defer the proposed 0.40% merchant discount rate on UPI payments above ₹2,000 from October 15, 2026 to January 1, 2027 after pushback from retailer associations.
featured.nri_angle: NRIs using UPI during visits to India or through its international acceptance pay nothing under the framework, since the fee falls on Indian merchants — but the fight over who funds UPI’s next phase shapes the system’s sustainability as it goes global.

just_in.excerpt: Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia told the 10th India Mobile Congress that India has 550 million 5G users — the fastest adoption anywhere in the world — and set a goal of one billion by 2030, alongside a resolve to lead the world on 6G.
just_in.image_caption: Union Communications Minister Jyotiraditya Scindia addresses an audience at a podium. Scindia on Thursday set a target of one billion 5G users by 2030 while inaugurating the 10th India Mobile Congress in New Delhi.
just_in.nri_angle: India's 5G and 6G push is a career and investment signal for the diaspora's large telecom and AI workforce, while Modi's anti-fraud framework push addresses the cross-border scam calls diaspora families receive.

just_in.title: From India U19 to Team USA: Saurabh Netravalkar's Unlikely Cricket Journey
just_in.excerpt: A Mumbai boy who gave up professional cricket for a Cornell engineering degree rebuilt his career on weekend club games in California — and became the face of America's rise at the 2024 T20 World Cup.
just_in.image_caption: Saurabh Netravalkar celebrates in the USA jersey during the 2024 T20 World Cup. The left-arm pacer’s Super Over heroics against Pakistan made him one of the faces of American cricket’s rise.
just_in.nri_angle: Netravalkar's journey — from Mumbai's age-group cricket to a Cornell engineering degree and an Oracle career in California to starring for Team USA — captures the Indian-American experience of carrying two identities, and he has become one of the faces of cricket's growth in the United States.

just_in.title: Air India, Singapore Airlines Drop Codeshare Booking Rule on 126 Weekly Flights
just_in.excerpt: From October 15, travellers can book eligible Air India or Singapore Airlines flights between India and Singapore on a standalone basis through either carrier's channels, ending the requirement to pair codeshare legs from both airlines.
just_in.nri_angle: The rule change directly benefits the large Indian diaspora travelling between Singapore and India, giving them simpler standalone bookings on 126 weekly flights across eight Indian cities from October 15.

just_in.excerpt: Indian benchmarks extended their fall in midday trade on Thursday, October 8, a day after the RBI raised the repo rate to 5.50% and shifted its stance to 'calibrated tightening.' IT heavyweights TCS, Infosys and HCLTech bucked the selloff ahead of TCS's quarterly results.
just_in.image_caption: A red downward-trending arrow over a grid of falling bar charts and negative percentage figures. The Sensex and Nifty 50 both fell more than 1% in midday trade on Thursday, October 8, after the RBI's repo rate hike.

just_in.title: Viral Rat-in-Dosa Video Was an Extortion Plot, Mumbai Police Allege
just_in.excerpt: Days after a viral video allegedly showing a dead rat in a dosa cost Borivali's Radhakrishna Hotel its food licence, Mumbai police say the woman behind the complaint was caught red-handed accepting Rs 6 lakh in what they call an extortion bid.
just_in.image_caption: Stills from the viral video show a partially eaten dosa on a black plate, with a dark object visible in the food. The video, recorded at Borivali's Radhakrishna Hotel on September 24, led the Maharashtra FDA to suspend the eatery's licence.

news.excerpt: A pregnant woman and two children are among the dead after the front of a four-storey building near Idgah Machhli Mandi collapsed Wednesday afternoon; eleven were rescued and an inquiry into the cause is underway.

news.title: India's Diabetes Surge Threatens the Eyesight of Millions, Experts Warn
news.excerpt: With over 101 million Indians living with diabetes and 85% never screened for eye damage, the country's new 2025 guidelines push AI-assisted retinal screening — a warning that applies to South Asian communities abroad as well.
news.image_caption: Diabetic retinopathy causes damage to the blood vessels of the retina. Experts warn India's diabetes surge threatens the eyesight of millions.
news.nri_angle: South Asians abroad carry elevated diabetes risk at lower BMI thresholds and younger ages, so the annual dilated eye exam pushed in India's new retinopathy guidelines matters in the US and UK too.

news.title: Cancer Trial Drug Zavondemstat Works Through Unexpected Target, Study Finds
news.excerpt: A study in Nature Chemical Biology finds the drug acts mainly by blocking the DNA-building enzyme DHODH, not the KDM4 proteins it was designed to hit — with implications for patient selection in trials.
news.image_caption: A 3D illustration depicts cancer cells with branching tendrils against a tissue-like background. A study in Nature Chemical Biology reports that the clinical-trial drug zavondemstat kills cancer cells mainly by blocking the enzyme DHODH, not the KDM4 proteins it was designed to target.
news.nri_angle: The story is a cautionary data point for precision oncology: trial enrollment is only as useful as the accuracy of the mechanism the drug is assumed to hit, a standard that applies to patients wherever trials run.

news.excerpt: Tropical Storm Isaias formed Wednesday in the Gulf of Mexico with 50 mph winds and is forecast to strengthen into a Category 2 hurricane before landfall Friday night or Saturday along the Mississippi, Alabama or Florida panhandle coast.
news.image_caption: NOAA satellite image of Tropical Storm Isaias in the Gulf of Mexico on Oct. 7, 2026. The storm is forecast to strengthen into a Category 2 hurricane before making landfall late Friday or early Saturday on the northern Gulf Coast.

news.excerpt: The front portion of a four-storey building in New Seemapuri came down around 3:30 pm on Wednesday, killing a five-year-old and injuring at least seven; residents say cracks appeared after Tuesday night's Uttarakhand earthquake tremors.
news.image_caption: Rescue workers and residents clear rubble after the front portion of a four-storey building collapsed in New Seemapuri, Delhi, on October 7, 2026. A child was killed and at least seven people were injured; the cause of the collapse is under investigation.

news.image_caption: Justice Surya Kant, the Chief Justice of India, will decide how the Supreme Court handles the curative plea against part of its September 23 split verdict on the Election Commissioners appointment law.

nri-world.excerpt: The New Hampshire Tech Alliance honored the ePropelled founder at its October 6 Innovation Summit, capping a four-decade career that runs from Nashoba Networks to a global propulsion company with an engineering center in Chennai.
nri-world.image_caption: ePropelled founder and CEO Nick Grewal (left) poses with former New Hampshire Governor Chris Sununu. Grewal was named the New Hampshire Tech Alliance's 2026 Entrepreneur of the Year at its October 6 Innovation Summit in Nashua.
nri-world.nri_angle: ePropelled's engineering and development center in Chennai puts Indian engineers at the heart of a global propulsion-tech supply chain, linking Grewal's recognition directly to Indian tech talent.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Brooklyn Comic Pooja Reddy Turns Kentucky Roots Into Country Cabaret
nri-world.excerpt: Her one-woman show "Pooja Reddy is White Trash" at Joe's Pub uses stand-up and original country songs to explore a South Indian upbringing in rural Kentucky.
nri-world.image_caption: The Public Theater on Lafayette Street in Manhattan, whose Joe's Pub venue hosted the premiere of Brooklyn comic Pooja Reddy's one-woman country cabaret, 'Pooja Reddy is White Trash,' this September.
nri-world.nri_angle: A second-generation Indian American turning a small-town Southern upbringing into art — Reddy's show speaks directly to diaspora kids raised far from any desi enclave, who grew up as the only brown face in the room.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Krishnamoorthi Condemns 240% Surge in Anti-South Asian Hate Posts on X
nri-world.excerpt: The Illinois Democrat cited a new study counting 542,360 hateful posts targeting South Asians in 18 months, and named a Texas candidate's post and a DHS graphic as examples.
nri-world.image_caption: Rep. Raja Krishnamoorthi (D-Ill.), who condemned the surge in anti-South Asian hate posts on X.
nri-world.nri_angle: Directly about the South Asian American experience: a measurable 240% surge in online hate, tied by a leading Indian American lawmaker to mainstream political rhetoric — a civil-rights issue the community is being asked to confront publicly.
tags: Center for the Study of Organized Hate
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Ghana to Seek BRICS Membership, Asks India's Backing During Jaishankar Visit
nri-world.excerpt: Ghana's cabinet has decided to pursue BRICS membership and asked New Delhi to guide its bid; the two sides also signed MoUs on agriculture and science and technology during the EAM's October 6–7 visit.
nri-world.image_caption: External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar with Ghana's President John Mahama in Accra. Ghana is seeking India's backing for BRICS membership. (PTI)
nri-world.nri_angle: Ghana hosts one of West Africa's most established Indian business communities in trade, manufacturing, and pharmaceuticals — the exact sectors both governments prioritized, and a BRICS seat with Indian backing could ease the path for Indian firms operating there.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Flydubai Co-Pilot Confesses Gaza Revenge Motive, Had Planned Ben Gurion Crash
nri-world.excerpt: Hamam al-Hammami told investigators he sought an airline job to carry out the attack and wanted to die a martyr; investigators are now probing whether he acted alone, while Captain Smit Machchhar recovers from a fractured skull.
nri-world.image_caption: A Flydubai Boeing 737-800. Co-pilot Hamam al-Hammami allegedly planned to crash Flight FZ1073 into Ben Gurion Airport in revenge for Gaza.
nri-world.nri_angle: An Indian pilot's heroism saved Flight FZ1073, and his recovery continues; the case also spotlights aviation-security gaps that matter to the millions of Indians who fly Gulf routes every year.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: India's Young Astronomers Shine With Four Golds and a Silver in Hanoi
nri-world.excerpt: All five Indian students medalled at the 19th International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics, placing India joint third among 64 countries in the biggest IOAA ever held.
nri-world.image_caption: The Indian team holds the national flag at the 19th International Olympiad on Astronomy and Astrophysics in Hanoi, medals around their necks. All five students medalled — four golds and one silver — placing India joint third among 64 countries.
nri-world.nri_angle: The IOAA triumph gives diaspora families a concrete window into India's HBCSE Olympiad pipeline — the training system behind the medals and a path many Indian-origin students abroad try to emulate — while underscoring the strength of the science education system many diaspora careers were built on.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

nri-world.title: Chennai's Indian Fine Arts Society Honours Its Young Carnatic Stars
nri-world.excerpt: More than 20 children took prizes at the 93-year-old sabha's annual music competition, with top winners receiving Thanjavur tamburas at a ceremony in Alwarpet on Sunday.
nri-world.image_caption: Winners of the Indian Fine Arts Society's annual music competition pose with their prizes in Chennai. More than 20 children received prizes at the ceremony on Sunday.
nri-world.nri_angle: NRIs planning Margazhi-season trips to Chennai can catch this next generation of Carnatic musicians as they move from student competitions onto the December concert stage.
nri-world.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: October Visa Bulletin Restores EB-2 India, but Green Card Wait Still Tops 11 Years
immigration.excerpt: The State Department’s October 2026 Visa Bulletin reopens EB-2 India and moves EB-1 forward as fiscal 2027 numbers arrive — but Indian applicants still face cutoffs more than a decade behind the rest of the world.
immigration.image_caption: A U.S. permanent resident card (green card). The October 2026 Visa Bulletin restores EB-2 India and advances EB-1, though Indian applicants still face final-action cutoffs more than 11 years behind most other countries.
immigration.nri_angle: The October bulletin gives Indian professionals stuck on H-1B status for years a rare concrete opening — a filing window that can unlock work authorization, travel flexibility, and job-change portability even as the underlying decade-long backlog persists.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Award-Winning Kashmiri Filmmaker Arfat Sheikh Detained by ICE at Dulles Airport
immigration.excerpt: The 42-year-old director of "Saffron Kingdom" was arrested September 24 after arriving from California; DHS says he overstayed lawful admittance, while his supporters say he had a pending immigration application and work authorization.
immigration.image_caption: The main terminal of Washington Dulles International Airport at dusk. Kashmiri filmmaker Arfat Sheikh was detained by ICE at Dulles on arrival.
immigration.nri_angle: The ICE detention of an award-winning Kashmiri filmmaker with a pending asylum application signals heightened risk for immigrants in legal limbo; DHS says a pending application does not confer legal status.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Indian Workers Begin Signing Payout Deals in €31 Million Milan Consulate Settlement
immigration.excerpt: Nearly 300 workers, most recruited in India, will receive an average of €50,000 each in back pay and damages after prosecutors found they were paid less than $2 an hour on the U.S. consulate construction site.
immigration.image_caption: Scaffolding covers the construction site of the new U.S. Consulate General in Milan, with a worker in an orange vest visible on the structure. Prosecutors found that nearly 300 workers on the project, most recruited in India, were paid less than $2 an hour, and workers have begun signing payout deals under a nearly €31 million settlement.
immigration.nri_angle: Most of the exploited workers were recruited in India; the settlement shows how overseas Indian labourers can use host-country legal protections to recover wages and secure residence status.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Ontario Calls in Police as College Recruitment Pipeline Under Scrutiny
immigration.excerpt: Ontario has referred suspected criminal misuse of student financial aid at private career colleges to provincial police, after inspectors linked student accounts and $219 million in public funds to a network of immigration recruitment firms.
immigration.image_caption: An Ontario Provincial Police cruiser. Ontario has referred suspected criminal misuse of student financial aid at private career colleges to the OPP for investigation.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian students are the primary market for the recruitment pipeline under scrutiny; families paying lakhs in agent fees face the greatest losses when colleges lose aid eligibility or collapse.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Unions and Universities Sue Over USCIS Green Card Rules Targeting Adjustment of Status
immigration.excerpt: The federal lawsuit challenges a May policy that treats seeking a green card from inside the US as a negative factor and an August policy letting officers deny applications without requesting more evidence — even for cases filed before the rules existed.
immigration.nri_angle: Indian nationals form the largest employment-based green card cohort with years-long backlogs, making them the likeliest casualties of policies that penalize staying in the US while an application is pending.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Reported $100,000 OPT Fee Nears Publication, Putting International Students' Work Rights at Risk
immigration.excerpt: The Department of Homeland Security's proposed "Optional Practical Training Fees" rule has cleared White House review and could soon be published for public comment — attaching a reported six-figure price tag to the post-graduation work program used by hundreds of thousands of foreign graduates each year.
immigration.image_caption: A graphic illustrating the proposed $100,000 fee on the Optional Practical Training program for international graduates. The DHS proposal cleared White House review on September 11, 2026 and now awaits publication in the Federal Register.
immigration.nri_angle: With 363,019 Indian students in the US — the largest international student cohort — a six-figure OPT fee would fall hardest on Indian families financing American degrees and the STEM pipeline they feed.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: US Moves to Strip Citizenship From 40 People in Largest Denaturalization Push Yet
immigration.excerpt: The Justice Department filed 40 denaturalization cases between Aug. 21 and Oct. 2 against naturalized citizens accused of serious crimes and immigration fraud — the biggest such push in modern US history.
immigration.image_caption: A U.S. passport. The government has moved to strip citizenship from 40 people in the largest denaturalization drive in decades.
immigration.nri_angle: One Indian national is named among the 40 denaturalization targets, and the sweeping push puts the large Indian naturalized population and N-400 applicants on notice that concealment on immigration forms — however old — can now trigger loss of citizenship.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: September's Global Immigration Shifts: What Changed for Visa Seekers Worldwide
immigration.excerpt: From Australia's new skilled-visa priority rules to Japan's twentyfold permanent residence fee hike and a UK settlement overhaul on the horizon, September brought rule changes that directly affect Indian migrants.
immigration.image_caption: WR Immigration's September 2026 global immigration recap graphic. The recap covers rule changes in Canada, Australia, the United Kingdom, Japan, Saudi Arabia, New Zealand, and Thailand.
immigration.nri_angle: Australia's onshore-first processing favors Indian students and graduates already in the country, while the UK's coming earned-settlement overhaul could reshape ILR eligibility for thousands of Indians nearing five years of residence.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

immigration.title: Montana Governor Lands in India to Rescue Lentil Exports Amid MAGA Backlash
immigration.excerpt: Governor Greg Gianforte is leading a 30-member delegation to India and Sri Lanka to rebuild the state's collapsed pulse trade, even as anti-India voices in his own party attack the trip.
immigration.image_caption: Montana Governor Greg Gianforte. He is leading a 30-plus member delegation to India and Sri Lanka, with reviving Montana's lentil exports to India the centerpiece of the trip.
immigration.nri_angle: The trip exposes a paradox for Indian Americans: anti-India voices demand the governor's impeachment while Montana's farm economy and universities actively court Indian consumers, students, and research ties.
immigration.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Sensex Tanks 900 Points, Nifty Slides Below 22,300 as RBI Hike Selloff Deepens
markets-finance.excerpt: Indian benchmarks extended their fall in midday trade on Thursday, October 8, a day after the RBI raised the repo rate to 5.50% and shifted its stance to 'calibrated tightening.' IT heavyweights TCS, Infosys and HCLTech bucked the selloff ahead of TCS's quarterly results.
markets-finance.image_caption: A red downward-trending arrow over a grid of falling bar charts and negative percentage figures. The Sensex and Nifty 50 both fell more than 1% in midday trade on Thursday, October 8, after the RBI's repo rate hike.
markets-finance.nri_angle: A near-record-low rupee means remitted dollars buy more rupees, but sustained FII selling and a rising-rate cycle are headwinds for NRI portfolios with Indian equity exposure.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Asia Stocks Fall as Oil Surge, Rising Yields Weigh; Samsung Slips on Record Profit
markets-finance.excerpt: MSCI's Asia-Pacific index fell 0.3% on Thursday as Brent crude topped $104 a barrel on U.S.-Iran escalation fears and 10-year Treasury yields neared multi-decade highs. Samsung Electronics slid despite a record $80 billion quarterly profit after the result fell short of some analyst estimates.
markets-finance.image_caption: The market centre at the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Asian stocks fell as surging oil prices and rising bond yields weighed on markets.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Surging oil prices and rising U.S. yields are direct headwinds for India as a major oil importer, pressuring the rupee, fuel prices and foreign investor flows into Indian equities.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Foreign Investors Pulled ₹21,745 Crore From Indian Stocks in Late September
markets-finance.excerpt: Foreign portfolio investors sold ₹21,745 crore ($2.3 billion) of Indian equities in the second half of September, intensifying a selloff led by financials, oil & gas, and auto stocks as rising US yields and crude prices drove a global allocation reset.
markets-finance.image_caption: A candlestick stock chart illustrating the September 2026 wave of foreign outflows from Indian equities. FPIs withdrew roughly Rs 35,860 crore from Indian stocks during the month.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For NRIs with Indian equity exposure, the selloff is a global-allocation rotation rather than an India-specific verdict — and with domestic institutions absorbing more than foreigners sold, SIP flows and large-cap entry points look healthier than the outflow headlines suggest.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Fed Minutes Signal Another Rate Hike by Year-End as Officials Split on Why
markets-finance.excerpt: Minutes from the Fed's September meeting show all 19 policymakers backed the quarter-point increase to 3.75%-4%, with most expecting one more hike this year — but sharply divided over the reason for tightening.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Marriner S. Eccles Federal Reserve Board Building in Washington, DC. Minutes from the Fed's September meeting signal another rate hike by year-end.
markets-finance.nri_angle: Higher US borrowing costs directly shape dollar-denominated household budgets — mortgages, auto and credit-card debt, and savings yields — for the diaspora's US-based readers.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Americans' One-Year Inflation Expectations Hit 3.9%, Highest Since May 2023
markets-finance.excerpt: The New York Fed's September Survey of Consumer Expectations shows households bracing for faster price growth across gas, food, rent, medical care and college costs — keeping the central bank on track for another rate hike before year end.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Marriner S. Eccles Federal Reserve Board Building in Washington, DC. The New York Fed's Survey of Consumer Expectations showed one-year inflation expectations rising to 3.9%, the highest since May 2023.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For the diaspora, higher-for-longer US rates keep mortgage and loan costs elevated while supporting the dollar — a direct factor in remittance value and NRI portfolio returns.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: RBI Hikes Repo Rate to 5.50% in First Increase in Nearly Four Years
markets-finance.excerpt: The six-member MPC voted unanimously to raise rates and shifted its stance to "calibrated tightening" as inflation climbs to 4.8%.
markets-finance.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India tower in Mumbai. The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee raised the repo rate to 5.50% on October 7, 2026, its first hike in nearly four years.
markets-finance.nri_angle: A firmer rate differential should support the rupee against a strong dollar, which matters for remittance timing; meanwhile NRIs with Indian home loans will see EMIs edge up, while NRI deposit and FCNR returns should improve as banks pass through higher rates.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Gold Coils Below $4,150 as Markets Await the Fed's Minutes
markets-finance.excerpt: Bullion slipped as the dollar and Treasury yields climbed, with traders pricing an 85% chance of a December rate hike ahead of the September FOMC minutes.
markets-finance.image_caption: A dollar symbol rests on a golden weighing pan. Gold eased to $4,150 an ounce on Wednesday as a stronger dollar and rising Treasury yields pressured the metal ahead of the Federal Reserve meeting minutes.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For Indian investors, the global pullback contrasts with strong domestic festive-season demand — with 24-karat gold around Rs 1.49 lakh per 10 grams in India, how much of that demand offsets macro headwinds will shape the metal's next move.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Nvidia Nears $6 Trillion on Record Highs and Biggest Buyback Ever
markets-finance.excerpt: Shares hit a record $239.11 as the AI chipmaker closes in on the first-ever $6 trillion market cap, powered by a $150 billion buyback and a $108 billion revenue outlook.
markets-finance.image_caption: Nvidia headquarters in Santa Clara, California. The AI chipmaker closed at a record high this week, pushing its market value toward $5.8 trillion.
markets-finance.nri_angle: For diaspora investors with US retirement accounts, Nvidia's roughly 7–8% weight in the S&P 500 means its swings land directly in index portfolios, whether or not they hold the stock itself.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Indian Banks Face a Q2 Paradox: FCNR Flood Boosts Loans, Squeezes Margins
markets-finance.excerpt: Brokerages expect Q2FY27 bank earnings to rise about 11%, powered by 18.8% credit growth and $127 billion of FCNR deposits — but the foreign-currency funding is set to shave 8–20 basis points off net interest margins.
markets-finance.image_caption: An HDFC Bank branch in India, with a pedestrian walking past the entrance. HDFC Bank grew deposits 19% year-on-year in Q2FY27, outpacing its loan growth of over 15%.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The $127 billion came from NRI pockets, and FCNR(B) deposits' foreign-currency denomination keeps depositors' returns free of rupee risk — though rates on fresh deposits are likely to soften as banks deploy the liquidity.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: World Bank Raises India's FY27 Growth Forecast to 7.1%, Flags AI as Next Driver
markets-finance.excerpt: The multilateral lender lifted its 2026/27 estimate by 50 basis points on resilient domestic demand, while warning that oil prices, El Niño and market volatility threaten the outlook.
markets-finance.image_caption: The World Bank Group logo displayed on a wall at the institution’s headquarters. The Bank on Tuesday raised India’s 2026/27 GDP growth forecast to 7.1% from 6.6%, citing resilient domestic demand and strong remittances.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The RBI is expected to raise rates on Oct 7 for the first time since 2023, which would lift NRE/NRO deposit yields for NRIs while raising borrowing costs in India; the World Bank also credits strong diaspora remittances as a pillar of India's resilient domestic demand.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Japanese Companies Exit China in Record Numbers as India Emerges as Alternative
markets-finance.excerpt: Teikoku Databank counts 10,118 Japanese companies in mainland China, down 30% from the 2012 peak, as firms shift investment toward India and Southeast Asia.
markets-finance.image_caption: The national flags of China and Japan appear side by side. Japanese companies have cut their presence in China to the lowest level since 2010, with 10,118 firms operating there as of June 2026, according to Teikoku Databank.
markets-finance.nri_angle: The pivot benefits India directly: Japanese manufacturers shifting capacity to India feed order books for industrial parks, logistics and suppliers — a concrete demand tailwind for India-focused investment portfolios.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

markets-finance.title: Schneider Electric to Buy PTC for $22.6 Billion in Its Biggest Deal Ever
markets-finance.excerpt: The $205-a-share all-cash offer, a 42.3% premium, sent PTC shares up nearly 34% on Monday. Schneider's stock fell about 10% in Paris as investors weighed the price and the up-to-EUR-23-billion financing plan.
markets-finance.image_caption: Schneider Electric’s headquarters. The French engineering group agreed to acquire US industrial software company PTC for $22.6 billion in cash.
markets-finance.nri_angle: No direct impact for most readers, but the deal is another major bet on data-centre and industrial-AI infrastructure, a sector employing a large Indian tech workforce in the US and Europe.
markets-finance.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: 71% of India's Asian Games Medals Came From Just Five Sports
sports.excerpt: Athletics, shooting, archery, boxing and wrestling produced 60 of India's 85 medals at Aichi-Nagoya 2026 — a concentration that keeps India fourth in Asia but raises questions about Olympic breadth.
sports.image_caption: India's men's hockey team celebrates on the field at the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya. India finished fourth with 85 medals, but 71% of them came from just five sports: athletics, shooting, archery, boxing and wrestling.
sports.nri_angle: The diaspora follows the Asian Games as a barometer of India's rise — the cricket, kabaddi and hockey golds travelled through community screenings worldwide — but the narrow medal base shows the sports pipeline is still concentrated in a few disciplines.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Young Indian Wrestlers Denied US Visas Ahead of U23 World Championships in Las Vegas
sports.excerpt: Nine of 16 Indian wrestlers who appeared for visa interviews at the US Embassy in New Delhi were refused on Wednesday — told they were below 20 and unemployed; the WFI has asked the embassy to reconsider ahead of Thursday’s appointments.
sports.image_caption: Kushti wrestlers grapple in a sand akhara in Varanasi. Young Indian wrestlers were denied US visas ahead of the U23 World Championships in Las Vegas.
sports.nri_angle: Indian fans in the US may watch a home-soil world championship without India's full squad, in a year when young Indians are facing tightened US visa scrutiny across categories.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Pramod Bhagat, Bhavina Patel to Lead India at Asian Para Games
sports.excerpt: The two Tokyo Paralympic medallists will carry the tricolour at the opening ceremony in Nagoya as India sends 121 athletes to the October 18–24 Games.
sports.image_caption: Para-badminton star Pramod Bhagat, Tokyo 2020 Paralympic gold medallist, will carry India's flag alongside table-tennis medallist Bhavina Patel at the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games opening ceremony.
sports.nri_angle: The Indian diaspora in Japan gets a rare home-soil chance to support the country's para-athletes in person at the Aichi-Nagoya Games.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Sujeet Kalkal's Comeback From 2-9 Down Wins Asian Games Wrestling Gold
sports.excerpt: The 23-year-old Indian beat Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiev 10-9 in the men's 65kg freestyle final at Aichi-Nagoya on October 2, ending India's eight-year wait for an Asian Games wrestling gold.
sports.image_caption: Sujeet Kalkal celebrates with the Indian tricolor after his Asian Games victory. The 23-year-old fought back from 2-9 down to beat Tajikistan's Abdulmazhid Kudiev 10-9 in the men's 65kg freestyle final at Aichi-Nagoya on October 2.
sports.nri_angle: A 23-year-old from Bhiwani's stunning comeback ended an eight-year gold drought — the kind of underdog sporting moment that rallies the global Indian diaspora around the tricolor.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: The Big Sister Who Taught India to Win: Harmanpreet Kaur's Captaincy Legacy
sports.excerpt: Harmanpreet Kaur stepped down after 14 years as India women's captain, leaving behind the country's first senior ICC title and a winning culture that will outlast her.
sports.image_caption: Harmanpreet Kaur, who stepped down this week as India women captain — the most successful captain in women's T20I history with 77 wins.
sports.nri_angle: Harmanpreet Kaur stepped down as India women's captain, closing a 14-year leadership era crowned by the 2025 ODI World Cup title and the most T20I wins of any captain in history.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Smriti Mandhana Named India Women's Full-Time Captain as Harmanpreet Steps Down
sports.excerpt: The BCCI named Mandhana all-format captain hours after Harmanpreet Kaur stood down following the Asian Games gold; Shafali Verma and Deepti Sharma are the new vice-captains.
sports.image_caption: Smriti Mandhana and Shafali Verma of the India women's cricket team during a match. Mandhana was named full-time captain on Tuesday, with Verma appointed as her T20I vice-captain.
sports.nri_angle: Mandhana is one of the most followed Indian sportswomen globally; her elevation is a landmark moment for young diaspora fans who have watched women's cricket move to prime time.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Shreyas Iyer's Maiden T20I Ton Powers India to Eight-Wicket Win Over West Indies
sports.excerpt: The India captain's unbeaten 102 off 43 balls — the first T20I hundred by an Indian skipper in a run chase — sealed an eight-wicket win with 32 balls to spare in Lucknow.
sports.image_caption: Shreyas Iyer raises his bat and helmet after reaching his maiden T20I century. His unbeaten 102 off 43 balls powered India to an eight-wicket win over West Indies in the series opener at Lucknow.
sports.nri_angle: A record-setting night for India's T20 captain, delivered hours after the squad returned from Asian Games gold — the kind of statement win diaspora fans watch for as the team builds toward the next World Cup cycle.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Neeru Dhanda Leads India's Sign-Off as Asian Games Close in Aichi-Nagoya
sports.excerpt: Trap shooter Neeru Dhanda, with two golds and a silver, carried the tricolour at Nagoya's Mizuho Park Stadium as India finished fourth with 85 medals — its second-best Asian Games tally.
sports.image_caption: The Mizuho Park Athletic Stadium in Nagoya hosted the closing ceremony of the 2026 Asian Games. Trap shooter Neeru Dhanda, who won two gold medals and a silver, carried India's tricolour as flag-bearer.
sports.nri_angle: India's 85-medal finish gives diaspora communities a shared moment of national sporting pride — the shooting, cricket and golf golds resonating with Indian-origin sports fans worldwide.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Pragyan Ojha Takes Interim Charge as BCCI Chief Selector After Agarkar Exit
sports.excerpt: With Ajit Agarkar's contract expiring October 4, the BCCI asked senior-most selector Pragyan Ojha — a 24-Test veteran — to take charge; he is also a leading candidate for the permanent role.
sports.image_caption: Pragyan Ojha takes interim charge as BCCI chief selector after Ajit Agarkar's departure.
sports.nri_angle: India's chief selector shapes the team the global diaspora follows most closely — and the permanent appointment will determine who picks the 2027 World Cup squad, the most-watched Indian team event of the decade for overseas fans.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: India Take on West Indies in Lucknow as T20I Series Begins Tuesday
sports.excerpt: The first of five T20Is starts at 7 p.m. IST on October 6 at Lucknow's Ekana Stadium, with Shreyas Iyer leading a young Indian side against Shai Hope's West Indies. Star Sports and JioHotstar carry the game in India; Willow TV streams it in the US.
sports.image_caption: The BCCI and West Indies Cricket logos on a series graphic. India and the West Indies open a five-match T20I series at Lucknow's Ekana Stadium on October 6, with Shreyas Iyer leading India and Shai Hope captaining the visitors.
sports.nri_angle: US-based fans can catch the 7 p.m. IST start at 9:30 a.m. ET / 6:30 a.m. PT on Willow TV, as a new-look India auditions its next T20 generation against the West Indies.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: With Asian Games Gold Secured, India Hockey Eyes Los Angeles 2028
sports.excerpt: India's men defended their Asian Games hockey title with a 5-1 win over Malaysia, the women ended a 44-year wait against China, and both squads have booked direct tickets to LA 2028.
sports.image_caption: India's men's hockey team celebrates with gold medals behind an LA 2028 'Qualified' banner. The 5-1 win over Malaysia in the Asian Games final was India's first successful title defence and booked a direct Olympic berth.
sports.nri_angle: LA 2028 lets Indian-Americans watch India chase Olympic hockey gold on home soil for the first time, with both the men's and women's teams qualified directly.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

sports.title: Archery Premier League Returns to Hyderabad as Asian Games Stars Turn Rivals
sports.excerpt: Less than a week after India won nine Asian Games archery medals, the stars trade national jerseys for franchise rivalries in the Archery Premier League's second season, running October 8–18 in Hyderabad.
sports.image_caption: The Archery Premier League logo. Season 2 of the franchise archery league begins in Hyderabad on October 8, with 48 archers across six teams competing over 11 days.
sports.nri_angle: The APL gives Indian fans abroad a new way to follow archery — and an early look at the archers India will field at Los Angeles 2028, which many in the US diaspora will attend.
sports.author: Diaspora Desk

technology.title: UPI Merchant Fee Rollout May Be Deferred to January 2027 Amid Retailer Pushback
technology.excerpt: Less than a week before the 0.40% UPI merchant fee was due to begin, retailers and fintech firms are pressing NPCI to delay it until January 2027 — and a decision is expected within days.
technology.image_caption: A UPI payment being made via a smartphone QR code scan. India may defer the proposed 0.40% merchant discount rate on UPI payments above ₹2,000 from October 15, 2026 to January 1, 2027 after pushback from retailer associations.
technology.nri_angle: NRIs using UPI during visits to India or through its international acceptance pay nothing under the framework, since the fee falls on Indian merchants — but the fight over who funds UPI’s next phase shapes the system’s sustainability as it goes global.

travel.title: Air India Ends Mainline International Flights From Chennai, Hands Singapore Route to Express
travel.excerpt: Chennai–Singapore goes twice-daily on Air India Express 737 MAX 8s from October 25, while mainline adds a daily Chennai–Muscat service — part of a group-wide winter reshuffle that also drops Copenhagen.
travel.image_caption: An Air India Express Boeing 737 takes off from a runway. The carrier takes over the Chennai–Singapore route from mainline Air India on October 25, operating it twice daily.
travel.nri_angle: Chennai–Singapore is a lifeline corridor for the Tamil diaspora; the route keeps 14 weekly flights but shifts to a low-cost cabin, changing baggage, meal and loyalty rules for regular flyers.

carousel.title: October Visa Bulletin Restores EB-2 India, but Green Card Wait Still Tops 11 Years
carousel.excerpt: The State Department’s October 2026 Visa Bulletin reopens EB-2 India and moves EB-1 forward as fiscal 2027 numbers arrive — but Indian applicants still face cutoffs more than a decade behind the rest of the world.
carousel.image_caption: A U.S. permanent resident card (green card). The October 2026 Visa Bulletin restores EB-2 India and advances EB-1, though Indian applicants still face final-action cutoffs more than 11 years behind most other countries.
carousel.nri_angle: The October bulletin gives Indian professionals stuck on H-1B status for years a rare concrete opening — a filing window that can unlock work authorization, travel flexibility, and job-change portability even as the underlying decade-long backlog persists.

carousel.title: India Brands Pakistan's Terrorism 'Frankenstein Monster' in Fiery UN Rebuke
carousel.excerpt: Delivering a right of reply at the UN General Assembly's Sixth Committee, diplomat Raghoo Puri said Pakistan has lost control of the terror proxies it built — and dismissed its Masood Azhar bounty hike as eyewash.
carousel.image_caption: An Indian diplomat speaks at the United Nations in New York. India's First Secretary Raghoo Puri used the General Assembly's Sixth Committee session to accuse Pakistan of doublespeak on terrorism.
carousel.nri_angle: The Pahalgam attack struck tourists including holidaying families, and diaspora households follow the 26/11 justice diplomacy closely; Pakistan's terror-financing record also affects trade and remittance corridors through compliance costs.

carousel.title: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer 2' Clears Censor Board, Locks 165-Minute Runtime Ahead of Release
carousel.excerpt: The Central Board of Film Certification has awarded the Nelson Dilipkumar sequel a U/A 16+ rating. The film releases in theatres worldwide on October 15, 2026.
carousel.image_caption: Rajinikanth appears in a promotional still as Muthuvel Pandian, his character in Jailer 2. The sequel has been certified U/A 16+ by the CBFC and releases in theatres worldwide on October 15, 2026.
carousel.nri_angle: Rajinikanth's overseas pull makes October 15 a date for the diaspora calendar; the Tamil diaspora in the US, Gulf and Southeast Asia historically turns his releases into opening-weekend events, and a day-and-date IMAX release gives overseas fans the same window as Chennai.

carousel.title: 71% of India's Asian Games Medals Came From Just Five Sports
carousel.excerpt: Athletics, shooting, archery, boxing and wrestling produced 60 of India's 85 medals at Aichi-Nagoya 2026 — a concentration that keeps India fourth in Asia but raises questions about Olympic breadth.
carousel.image_caption: India's men's hockey team celebrates on the field at the Asian Games in Aichi-Nagoya. India finished fourth with 85 medals, but 71% of them came from just five sports: athletics, shooting, archery, boxing and wrestling.
carousel.nri_angle: The diaspora follows the Asian Games as a barometer of India's rise — the cricket, kabaddi and hockey golds travelled through community screenings worldwide — but the narrow medal base shows the sports pipeline is still concentrated in a few disciplines.

carousel.title: UPI Merchant Fee Rollout May Be Deferred to January 2027 Amid Retailer Pushback
carousel.excerpt: Less than a week before the 0.40% UPI merchant fee was due to begin, retailers and fintech firms are pressing NPCI to delay it until January 2027 — and a decision is expected within days.
carousel.image_caption: A UPI payment being made via a smartphone QR code scan. India may defer the proposed 0.40% merchant discount rate on UPI payments above ₹2,000 from October 15, 2026 to January 1, 2027 after pushback from retailer associations.
carousel.nri_angle: NRIs using UPI during visits to India or through its international acceptance pay nothing under the framework, since the fee falls on Indian merchants — but the fight over who funds UPI’s next phase shapes the system’s sustainability as it goes global.

carousel.title: Sensex Tanks 900 Points, Nifty Slides Below 22,300 as RBI Hike Selloff Deepens
carousel.excerpt: Indian benchmarks extended their fall in midday trade on Thursday, October 8, a day after the RBI raised the repo rate to 5.50% and shifted its stance to 'calibrated tightening.' IT heavyweights TCS, Infosys and HCLTech bucked the selloff ahead of TCS's quarterly results.
carousel.image_caption: A red downward-trending arrow over a grid of falling bar charts and negative percentage figures. The Sensex and Nifty 50 both fell more than 1% in midday trade on Thursday, October 8, after the RBI's repo rate hike.
carousel.nri_angle: A near-record-low rupee means remitted dollars buy more rupees, but sustained FII selling and a rising-rate cycle are headwinds for NRI portfolios with Indian equity exposure.
